notes.title: Patch 1.4
Patch 1.2 - Pumpkin!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509179/590ff25e2ed59b7fef1b0b5bd296abbcdd260b05.gif
HALLOWEEN UPDATE

Halloween has fallen on the Tower of Babel, are you ready to challenge the darkness?
We are happy to announce that Demoniaca got a new and terrifying free expansion. Fabulous Pumpkin, the new boss, has returned to the tower, meaning that it's time for more fearsome bloodshed. But it won't be that easy - no one knows where Pumpkin is hiding. You will have to face trials and tests first before you finally fight her. 

The expansion contains 2 hours of gameplay, 3 new explorable Halloween-themed areas, several puzzles, a special item and new scary/sexy boss!

How to start the challenge?
Three new chests have appeared on the map. You will need to find and destroy them in order to activate secret portals that lead to new areas. Solve the puzzles in each of them and use clues to locate Pumpkin’s lair!

Requirements
This content will be accessible for players who have got through the first half of the game. At the end of this event a new special secret item will be gifted to those who completed the challenge.

Good hunting!

Hi!

Grand news! Patch 1.1 just aired! We have fixed numerous issues based on a feedback we got from you guys! Thank you! Stay tuned for even more exciting updates!

Changelog

 KEY MAPPING! Players can now configurate control scheme!
 Improved main character's movement, controls are now more responsive.
 Fixed the achievement bug, players can now get 100% of achievements!

 Unique items had been re-balanced.
 Improved English localization.
 Improved game stability and an overall performance.
 Minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: How to rock in Demoniaca
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509179/590ff25e2ed59b7fef1b0b5bd296abbcdd260b05.gif

Hi!

Demoniaca airs tomorrow! We are so hyped!
Demoniaca is easy to learn, but challenging to master. The devs have prepared a short tutorial - learn it and get the most of it! See you soon in the Tower of Babel!

Enjoy!

[olist]
Demoniaca is compatible with all the most popular controllers. Yes, you can use the keyboard but the game is designed to be fully enjoyable with a controller. Plug it!
During your journey things could become difficult, if you get stuck make sure you find a save room or teleport yourself to a safe place. All unsaved progress (items, exp, etc..) will be lost.
Each area contains secret passages and multiple directions, it's up to you to explore the map and figure out where to go. If you can't reach something you probably have to become more powerful.
The game has a complex RPG system, make sure you have equipped the best owned items and have all your Skill Points put to good use.
Use the mini-map to orient yourself, certain objects can increase the information visible on the mini-map.
Always try to understand the best move or strategy to deal with the enemy, that can make all the difference in the world!
Plug in a second joypad to share the gaming experience with a friend, it will keep you company during your journey.
Unique enemies are indicated with a star symbol on the map, in each area you will find one of them. Avoid the fight until you are strong enough.
Check the game Guide in the character menu to learn more about the game features.
This is an old style game, you will have to find out for yourself how to reach the top of the tower. Yes, you will have some clues, but no one will explicitly tell you what to do. This will leave you the freedom to explore and experiment with things that may work.
[/olist]

Are you ready?!
